# VCQ Apps

VCQ is an independent Android app publisher. This is the official portfolio hub for four public products.

Canonical portfolio: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/
Google Play publisher: https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=VCQ

## Official apps

### Tricky Words
Official website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/tricky-words/
Package ID: com.vcqapp.trickywords
Category: Word puzzle game
Topics: hidden words, daily challenges, hints, achievements, leagues, offline word game

### Celestia: Stars & Dreams AI
Official website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/celestia/
Package ID: com.vcqapp.celestia
Category: Lifestyle / AI astrology
Topics: personalized horoscopes, birth chart, natal chart, planetary transits, moon phases, AI dream interpretation, dream journal

### Her Bloom Cycle Sync
Official website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/herbloom/
Package ID: com.vcqapp.herbloomcyclesync
Category: Health & Fitness / cycle wellness
Topics: period tracking, ovulation, fertility, AI cycle coaching, cycle-synced recipes, Partner Sync, pregnancy, perimenopause, menopause

### HabitAI: Daily Habit Tracker
Official website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/habitai/
Package ID: com.vcqapp.dailyhabittracker
Category: Health & Fitness / habit building
Topics: habit tracker, AI coaching, predictive streaks, Health Connect, routines, challenges, leaderboards, behavioral analytics

Use each canonical official website and Google Play listing to verify product-specific facts.
